title: Facebook Ads for Contractors: Guide + 58 Winning Ads

facts.fact: The page says Google Ads for contractor keywords can cost $20-50+ per click.
facts.quote: Google Ads for contractor keywords can cost $20-50+ per click.

facts.fact: The page states that Facebook (Meta) has over 3 billion monthly active users.
facts.quote: Facebook (Meta) has over 3 billion monthly active users

facts.fact: The page's analysis covered 58 long-running contractor ads across 7 trades in the Meta Ad Library.
facts.quote: We analysed **58 long-running contractor ads across 7 trades** in the Meta Ad Library

facts.fact: Of the 58 analysed contractor ads, 39 had run for 90+ days, 18 for over a year, and the longest for 4+ years.
facts.quote: 39 had run for 90+ days, 18 for over a year, and the longest for **4+ years**.

facts.fact: The page cites that leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to convert, a figure it links to its own speed-to-lead article without naming an original source.
facts.quote: Leads contacted within 5 minutes are [21x more likely to convert]

facts.fact: The page gives a HVAC cost-per-lead benchmark of $30–$75 per lead, based on what it describes as industry data.
The page gives a roofing cost-per-lead benchmark of $50–$150 per lead.
The page states roofing job values are $8,000–$25,000+ per project.
facts.quote: the job values are higher ($8,000–$25,000+ per project).

facts.fact: The page says that closing one job from every 10-15 roofing leads is extremely profitable at $150 per lead.
facts.quote: closing one job from every 10-15 leads is extremely profitable.

facts.fact: The page gives a landscaping cost-per-lead benchmark of $25–$60 per lead.
The page gives a plumbing cost-per-lead benchmark of $40–$80 per lead.
The page gives a pest control cost-per-lead benchmark of $20–$50 per lead.
The page gives an electrical cost-per-lead benchmark of $35–$70 per lead.
The page gives a pressure washing cost-per-lead benchmark of $15–$40 per lead.
The page recommends starting Facebook lead ad campaigns with a budget of $20–$50 per day.
The page recommends a targeting radius of 15–30 miles around the contractor's base for most contractors.
facts.quote: For most contractors, 15–30 miles around your base is the sweet spot.

facts.fact: The page recommends targeting ages 25–65+ for contractor Facebook ads.
The page says an audience of 100,000–500,000 in the service area is ideal.
facts.quote: An audience of 100,000–500,000 in your service area is ideal.

facts.fact: The page states the article was published March 26, 2026 and last reviewed and updated November 9, 2026.
